title: CreateMy-QR
content_en:
Project Overview

CreateMy-QR is an advanced, privacy-guaranteed QR code and barcode suite. It empowers individuals and businesses to generate 37 distinct categories of QR codes and barcodes, complete with custom logo embedding, color styling, and high-resolution vector exports.

The Challenge

Most commercial QR generators lock basic features behind expensive subscriptions, inject tracking redirects that break when subscriptions expire, and collect sensitive scan telemetry.

The Solution

CreateMy-QR operates under a strict Zero Upload, Zero Tracking, Zero Compromise policy. All QR code matrix calculations and vector renderings adhere to official ISO/IEC 18004 standards and execute entirely within the user browser, resulting in permanent, static, and un-hijackable QR codes.

Key Features

  • 37 Supported Formats: Social media profiles, WiFi credentials, vCards, crypto payments, multi-links, and retail barcodes.
  • Custom Design Engine: Embed logos, custom shapes, gradients, and precision error correction levels (L, M, Q, H).
  • Vector & Raster Exports: Download instant high-res PNG, SVG, and PDF formats ready for print production.
  • Built-in Scanner: Web camera and file-based QR/barcode reader running client-side.

Ringkasan Proyek

CreateMy-QR adalah suite generator dan scanner QR code serta barcode canggih yang menjamin privasi. Memungkinkan individu dan bisnis membuat 37 kategori kode QR dan barcode lengkap dengan sematan logo kustom, pewarnaan dinamis, dan ekspor vektor resolusi tinggi.

Tantangan

Sebagian besar generator QR komersial mengunci fitur dasar di balik langganan berbayar yang mahal, menyuntikkan redirect pelacak yang rusak saat langganan berakhir, dan mengumpulkan data analitik pengguna tanpa izin.

Solusi Teknis

CreateMy-QR beroperasi di bawah kebijakan Zero Upload, Zero Tracking, Zero Compromise. Semua kalkulasi matriks kode QR dan rendering vektor mematuhi standar resmi ISO/IEC 18004 dan dieksekusi sepenuhnya di browser pengguna, menghasilkan kode QR yang permanen, statis, dan aman.

Fitur Utama

  • 37 Format Didukung: Profil media sosial, WiFi, vCard kontak, pembayaran crypto, multi-link, dan barcode ritel.
  • Mesin Desain Kustom: Sematkan logo, pola kustom, gradien warna, dan tingkat koreksi kesalahan presisi (L, M, Q, H).
  • Ekspor Vektor & Raster: Unduh instan dalam format PNG resolusi tinggi, SVG, dan PDF siap cetak.
  • Pemindai Terintegrasi: Pembaca QR/barcode via kamera web dan file secara lokal.
